First, we apply the addition principle, adding $4$ to both sides:

$$
\begin{aligned}10x-4 & >16 \\ 10x-4+4 & >16+4 \\ 10x+0 & >20 \\ 10x & >20\end{aligned}
$$

Second, we apply the multiplication principle, dividing both sides by $10{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}10x & >20 \\ \frac{10x}{10} & >\frac{20}{10} \\ \frac{\cancel{10}x}{\cancel{10}} & >2 \\ x & >2\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x> 2.$
